b.text: Felicia Albanese was born in Torre Pelosa.
Albanese died at the age of 105 in her home in Manhattan.

a.text: Albanese became a leading artist with the Metropolitan Opera.

b.text: Albanese made her Metropolitan Opera debut in the first of 72 performances as Madama Butterfly.

a.text: Albanese's tenure as a leading artist with the Metropolitan Opera ended.

b.text: She left the Met in a dispute with General Manager Sir Rudolf Bing.

a.text: She made her unofficial debut in Milan, replacing another soprano in Puccini's Madama Butterfly.

b.text: She made her formal debut at the Teatro Municipale in Bari, singing in La bohème.

a.text: Arturo Toscanini invited Albanese to join his broadcast concert performances of La bohème and La traviata with the NBC Symphony Orchestra.

b.text: Arturo Toscanini invited Albanese to sing Mimì in the 1946 NBC Symphony Orchestra performance of La bohème.

b.text: Toscanini cast her again as Violetta in a performance of La traviata broadcast nationally on NBC Radio on December 1 and 8, 1946.
